expression_contract.conv_activation: SiLU in FP32, then cast qkv to activation dtype
expression_contract.conv_history: three prior raw qkv rows, oldest to newest
expression_contract.conv_product: multiply in activation dtype, cast each rounded product to FP32, accumulate left-to-right from FP32 bias
expression_contract.projection_layout: q,k,v,z and b,a; z is not recurrent
expression_contract.publication: form output from FP32 next state, then cast/publish state at every node
expression_contract.qk_normalization: FP32 L2 norm with epsilon 1e-6; q scaled by K^-0.5

binary.node_state_row_rule: node i publishes post-node state to row i+1
binary.source_state_row_rule: root reads row 0; node i reads parent[i]+1
